title: Conversion
wikitext:
'''Conversion''' may refer to: 

* [[Damage conversion]]
* Conversion of non-damage stats, such as {{psl|Iron Reflexes}}'s evasion into armour, or {{il|Presence of Chayula}}'s life into energy shield. 
* {{il|Conversion Trap}}'s ability to turn enemies into temporary allies
* Conversion of dropped items by [[List of monster reward mods|monster reward modifiers]]

[[Damage taken as]] is sometimes referred to as conversion. While similar, it is a separate mechanic with different rules.
